title: Sage attribute record
description: A attribute record (AttributeRecord). Generated by `sage schema` from the metadata table (issue #21).

$schema.description: The JSON Schema an editor checks this file with; the game ignores it.

id.description: The record's id: name (this file's namespace) or namespace:name. A second definition of an id is an error; change one with "patch".

base.description: Inherit every field from another attribute record, resolved after patches; this record's own fields win.

patch.description: true: change a record defined earlier in load order, field by field, instead of defining one. Objects merge; lists replace unless written "field+" (add) or "field-" (remove).

abstract.description: true: a template, usable as a "base" and never built into a record itself.

disabled.description: true (in a patch): remove the record.

start.description: The value an entity starts with. Category: Vitals. (float, default 0)

min.description: The lowest the value can go; it is clamped here. Category: Vitals. (float, default 0)

max.description: The highest the value can go; it is clamped here. Category: Vitals. (float)

spendEffect.description: The effect that spends one unit of this attribute (mana, stamina) Names a effect record. (RecordRef<EffectRecord>)
